title: A Goodness-of-Fit Test for Independent Component Models in High Dimensions
summary: Independent component (IC) models are a standard tool for representing multivariate data in statistics, signal processing, and machine learning. Despite the extensive use of IC models, much less attention has been given to goodness-of-fit tests for assessing their compatibility with data. We develop the first goodness-of-fit test for IC models that is supported by a theoretical validity guarantee when the data dimension and sample size diverge proportionally.
